resolved.description: The exact display name, empty when the query matched nothing or more than one thing.

candidates.description: What matched. More than one is a question for the user, not a list to pick from.

spell_type.description: Sorcery or Incantation. It decides which catalysts can cast it.

forms.description: Every named form of this spell — the plain cast, its charged variants, and each numbered hit of a multi-hit one. They have different attack values.

families.description: The schools it belongs to, which is what a catalyst's family bonus keys on.

base_attack.description: Its own attack per damage type, before any catalyst. All zero for a buff.

fp_cost.description: The spell's own cost. What a catalyst charges is spell-power's fp_cost_actual.

cast_from.description: The kind of catalyst that can cast it, so the next call is not an impossible one.
